scenarios.title: Pay a 25 USDC invoice
scenarios.objective: Go to {url}. Click 'Connect wallet'. If a button labelled 'Switch to Sepolia Testnet' is visible, click it. Type {recipient} into 'Recipient address' and {amount} into 'Amount (USDC)'. Before clicking Approve, read the payment summary and store the recipient as 'ui_recipient', the amount as 'ui_amount', the network as 'ui_network' and the allowance you approve as 'ui_approval_amount'. Then click the Approve button and wait until the page says 'Approved'. Then click the Pay button and wait until 'Payment sent' appears. There is no wallet popup: the test wallet confirms by itself. Do not edit any value after you have stored them.
